items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I think I played only one job with him... Georgie Brunas was playing some wrong... I think we played a parade one day.

ctx.x: I think I played only one job with him. Well, I was really playing with his son. With his son. His son played cornet, but he happened to play bass drum. I think we played a parade one day. Georgie Brunas was playing some wrong, and I think Emmet Rogers played the snare drum that day, and Jack played bass drum. Of course, we were kids then.
Yeah. He said he had a lot of boys working for him. All the Brunas brothers were pretty young when they worked for him and started with him.
